science.title: Six mushrooms, one daily dropper
science.text: Functional mushrooms have been used for centuries to support immunity and resilience. We blend a proprietary complex of chaga, reishi, maitake, shiitake and turkey tail with cordyceps, then deliver it as an easy liquid tincture your body can take in quickly — a few drops under the tongue or in any drink.

format.title: Mushrooms in a dropper, not a pill
format.text: No earthy capsules or powders to choke down. One dropper of naturally-flavoured, stevia-sweetened tincture — straight under the tongue or stirred into water, coffee or a smoothie.
